data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 棋盘前的一步
data.description: 轮到她走棋时，巴泽特拿起棋子停了一会儿，仔细看向棋盘另一端。
data.action: holding a game piece above the board
data.promptProse: Sitting at a heavy oak pub table beside a crackling peat fireplace, Bazett hovers a carved wooden chess piece over a board, analyzing tactical combinations with intense, steely resolve. A half-pint of dark stout, scattered matchsticks, and the weathered wood grain of the tavern interior reflect her sharp, analytical mind at rest.
